item.title: Wie die elektronische Rechnungsprüfung KI sicher nutzt
item.author: handelszeitung.ch
item.description: Neuartige Systeme nutzen eine andere Strategie: Die Prüfung erfolgt durch ein separates KI-System, der Entscheid wird aus Regeln zusammengestellt, die die KI laufend überwacht – samt Empfehlung an die Mitarbeitenden. Das bringt drei Vorteile: Die Abläufe können sich deutlich beschleunigen. Die Entscheidung bleibt beim Menschen und damit beim gesunden Menschenverstand. Und alle Prüfgrundlagen sind dauerhaft mit dem Entscheid verknüpft – lückenlose Nachvollziehbarkeit.

item.title: ECB’s Sleijpen Says Window Is Closing to Limit Warming Impact
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: European Central Bank Governing Council member Olaf Sleijpen said that the chance to limit global warming to the limit envisaged by the Paris Agreement is almost spent. “Scientific evidence shows that the remaining carbon budget consistent with limiting global warming to 1.5°C is now almost exhausted,” Sleijpen said in Manila on Monday.

item.title: Bond Market’s Big Short Bet Gets Wakeup Call as AI Trade Wobbles
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: US Treasuries are showing tentative signs of reclaiming their traditional role as a haven — threatening to wrong-foot investors who are heavily positioned for this year’s bond slump to deepen. As concerns mount across markets over the outlook for leading artificial-intelligence firms and the potential impact on the broader economy, 10-year yields fell about 17 basis points last week while the Nasdaq 100 Index tumbled 5.5%.

item.title: Korean Stocks Fall as DeepSeek Model, Funding Worry Rattle Chips
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: South Korean stocks resumed declines Monday, as DeepSeek’s latest model sparked concerns over demand for memory chips, compounding market worries over AI financing. The benchmark Kospi dropped as much as 3.2%, with chipmakers Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc. dropping more than 4% each before paring losses. Japan’s tech-heavy Nikkei 225 slid about 2%, with chip-equipment maker Advantest Corp. among the biggest decliners.

item.title: AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The concern is no longer just whether demand for AI chips will hold up. It’s whether hyperscalers and neocloud operators can keep financing the infrastructure needed to deploy them — and whether the expected returns will justify the scale of investment. Bonds of neocloud provider CoreWeave Inc. sank to levels signaling distress last week as investors questioned whether AI demand and revenue could support the borrowing behind its expansion.

item.title: BlackRock Sees Tokenized Funds Moving Into Wall Street Plumbing
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: “Questions relating to custody and segregation frameworks, capital and margin treatment, cross-border recognition and legal certainty must be addressed with industry standards and regulatory clarity,” said Scott O’Malia, chief executive at ISDA, the global derivatives industry body that sets widely used legal standards and documentation for derivatives trading and collateral.
